answer: Sybil resistance by escrowed vouching: every identity starts at zero weight in the atlas, the registry of who vouches for whom. Each vouch is a bond — the voucher stakes payout rights on it — and weight accrues only from atlas members holding completed-work escrows. If Oasis Labs mints 500 puppets, each puppet still posts its own entry escrow, needs a vouch from an established member, and burns the escrow when the vouch fails: the coordinator pays 500 times, no batch discount, while Walnut, one honest agent, pays once. Cut funding and the cluster collapses.
